summary: DAY adversarial review independently challenged every company in Chief's 12-name active T0 batch using cumulative still-valid primary evidence plus current-quarter company evidence and the exact 23:00Z machine/evidence state. Eleven companies remain red-team ready_for_chief with explicit concentration, financing, dilution, cycle, regulatory, substitution and execution failure paths preserved. SYM remains the only lane-specific hold because SEC Form 4 accession 0001932967-26-000007 is still pending and its transaction substance has not been adjudicated; the blocker is narrow and transaction-specific, and the batch was not stalled on it.

companies.redTeamCase: Meta commitments, NVIDIA partnership and secured GPU-backed financing validate demand and financing access but can conceal the core failure mode: very large capacity buildout must still earn acceptable utilization, margin and ROIC. Concentration and capital intensity rise alongside validation.
falsifiers: material delay/cancellation of committed capacity
capex growth materially outruns contracted gross profit and cash generation
financing terms deteriorate as buildout expands
customer diversification fails despite new capacity

companies.redTeamCase: Rapid revenue/RPO growth can obscure constellation replacement capex, government timing, concentration and historical financing/dilution. Contracted backlog is not equivalent to high-margin free cash flow.
falsifiers: RPO conversion weakens materially
replacement capex grows faster than gross profit/cash generation
government contract timing slips materially
share count expands without corresponding per-share cash generation

companies.redTeamCase: The strongest narrative trap remains category leakage: Groves/isotope milestones and lab/fuel-validation collaborations are not commercial Aurora reactor approval or bankable generation revenue. Framework demand can remain non-binding while licensing, fuel and project financing absorb capital.
falsifiers: Aurora licensing milestones slip materially
framework counterparties fail to convert to binding economic agreements
project economics require materially more capital/dilution than current treatment
fuel-cycle constraints delay deployment

companies.redTeamCase: AI-colocation/offtake can be overread while Q2 2026 still shows gross loss, net loss and major mining/capital exposure. The key trap is treating forward contracted AI revenue as present-quality earnings before residual funding, counterparty and margin economics are proven.
falsifiers: AI energization/service commencement slips
AI counterparties fail to perform or realized margins disappoint
residual capex produces substantial dilution/debt stress
mining capital demands continue to dominate cash use

companies.redTeamCase: Q2 growth, RPO expansion, SkyWater vertical integration and technical milestones are real, but the combined company now carries larger integration, capital-allocation and roadmap risk. Revenue growth does not yet establish fault-tolerant unit economics or durable normalized margins.
falsifiers: post-acquisition burn remains high without margin progression
manufacturing/roadmap milestones slip materially
integration produces repeated restructuring/impairment or large dilution
multi-product wins fail to repeat commercially

companies.redTeamCase: Strong Q3 growth/profitability and 77 systems in deployment do not neutralize extraordinary principal-customer concentration. A same-cycle Form 4 remains unresolved; filing type alone is not bearish, but transaction substance is required for reproducible current governance/alignment treatment.
companies.presentBlocker: GATING: interpret SEC Form 4 accession 0001932967-26-000007 at transaction level and classify whether it is routine/immaterial, a discretionary sale/disposition, an award/withholding event, dilution-relevant, or otherwise material to governance/alignment/insider-behavior treatment.
falsifiers: principal-customer deployments pause or economics are renegotiated
customer diversification fails while margins weaken
material discretionary insider disposal worsens alignment beyond current treatment
large backlog fails to convert on expected economics

companies.redTeamCase: Record fiscal-Q2 revenue and AI/custom-silicon optimism can mask direct-customer/distributor concentration, cyclicality and export sensitivity. Design wins should not receive full moat credit until diversified revenue, margin and cash conversion remain durable through the cycle.
falsifiers: major customer/distributor loss
custom-AI concentration rises while gross margin/cash conversion weakens
export controls materially reduce addressable demand
design-win ramps miss expected timing

companies.redTeamCase: AI-optics growth and margin expansion remain exposed to hyperscaler concentration, optical-cycle duration, capacity execution and leverage. Current pricing/yield gains may be partly cyclical rather than durable scarcity rent.
falsifiers: AI-datacenter growth decelerates sharply
capacity additions create pricing pressure before debt falls
top-customer concentration rises with receivable/inventory stress
deleveraging stalls during margin compression

companies.redTeamCase: Fiscal-Q4 AI-optics acceleration, NVIDIA partnership and U.S. capacity build are powerful positives, but debt equitization/share issuance, customer concentration and CPO architecture transitions create real per-share and obsolescence risk. A one-time non-cash accounting loss should not obscure the economic dilution.
falsifiers: share-count growth remains material
CPO transition disintermediates current product economics
major-customer concentration rises while margins normalize downward
capacity expansion outruns demand

companies.redTeamCase: Record AI/server power growth and high operating quality can obscure distributor/channel concentration, Taiwan/China exposure and outsourced manufacturing dependencies. Rapid Enterprise Data growth raises mix/concentration sensitivity rather than eliminating it.
falsifiers: channel inventory correction causes disproportionate revenue decline
Taiwan/China disruption materially constrains supply or end demand
new 300mm/800V programs fail qualification or create persistent cost drag
AI/server mix normalizes faster than capacity plans

companies.redTeamCase: Rapid CCS/HPS AI-infrastructure growth can create peak-cycle risk when customer concentration and hyperscaler bargaining power are high. Revenue acceleration must be separated from normalized margin durability, working-capital intensity and cash conversion.
falsifiers: top-customer growth reverses
working-capital/capex needs consume cash despite revenue growth
operating margin retraces as mix normalizes
hyperscaler program concentration increases materially

companies.redTeamCase: Diversification is genuine and organic growth is strong, but the large acquisition wave creates integration, leverage, synergy and capital-allocation risk. Reported growth must be decomposed so acquired revenue is not mistaken for organic moat expansion.
falsifiers: integration costs/synergies miss materially
leverage remains elevated while organic growth slows
large acquisitions reduce ROIC
cross-selling assumptions fail to materialize

contradictions: Validated demand at NBIS can increase both thesis confidence and concentration/capex-return risk.
BTDR forward AI demand reduces demand uncertainty without proving present earnings quality or reducing mining/capital beta.
IONQ technical and revenue milestones reduce specific uncertainty while the larger acquisition footprint increases integration/capital-allocation risk.
Strong AI-cycle results at MRVL/COHR/LITE/MPWR/CLS improve operating truth while increasing sensitivity to peak-cycle expectations and capacity normalization.
SYM's Form 4 is a real current event, but the existence of a Form 4 cannot be equated with bearish insider selling without transaction-level evidence.
APH diversification lowers customer concentration while acquisition intensity raises integration/leverage risk.
unknowns: Exact live crowding, short interest and consensus positioning are non-canonical T0 inputs and are not fabricated.
Future regulatory, technology-transition and renewal outcomes remain falsifiers rather than present blockers unless sourced contradictions emerge.
SYM accession 0001932967-26-000007 transaction substance remains unresolved and is the only company-specific lane blocker in this pass.
